name: test_page_has_title
scenario: Document has a non-empty <title> for screen readers / browser tabs
expected: driver.title is non-empty

name: test_html_lang_attribute_present
scenario: <html> declares a lang attribute (screen reader language detection)
expected: html[lang] attribute is present and non-empty

name: test_interactive_elements_lack_accessible_roles
scenario: Count interactive (tabindex=0) elements that expose no role/aria-label — a known gap
expected: Documented baseline: react-native-web Pressables here render with no ARIA role/label (see Accessibility Findings sheet)

name: test_no_horizontal_overflow_on_welcome_screen
scenario: Welcome screen content does not cause horizontal page overflow/scroll at 1440px width
expected: document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window innerWidth (+ small tolerance)

name: test_viewport_meta_tag_present
scenario: Responsive viewport meta tag is present (web/index.html)
expected: meta[name=viewport] exists with width=device-width

name: test_supabase_rest_root_reachable
scenario: Supabase REST endpoint (PostgREST root) responds
expected: HTTP response received (any status) proving the project URL is live/DNS-resolvable

name: test_supabase_auth_endpoint_rejects_bad_credentials
scenario: Supabase Auth token endpoint rejects invalid grant with a structured 400 (not a 5xx/crash)
expected: HTTP 400 with an error body, proving the Auth service is live and validating input

name: test_supabase_edge_function_deployed[assemblyai-transcribe]
scenario: Edge Function 'assemblyai-transcribe' is deployed and routed (supabase/functions/assemblyai-transcribe)
expected: Non-404 response (401/400/500 acceptable — proves the function exists); 404 means not deployed

name: test_supabase_edge_function_deployed[assemblyai-poll]
scenario: Edge Function 'assemblyai-poll' is deployed and routed (supabase/functions/assemblyai-poll)
expected: Non-404 response (401/400/500 acceptable — proves the function exists); 404 means not deployed

name: test_supabase_edge_function_deployed[groq-analysis]
scenario: Edge Function 'groq-analysis' is deployed and routed (supabase/functions/groq-analysis)
expected: Non-404 response (401/400/500 acceptable — proves the function exists); 404 means not deployed

name: test_supabase_edge_function_deployed[openai-proxy]
scenario: Edge Function 'openai-proxy' is deployed and routed (supabase/functions/openai-proxy)
expected: Non-404 response (401/400/500 acceptable — proves the function exists); 404 means not deployed

name: test_login_invalid_credentials_shows_error
scenario: Login with a non-existent email/password combination
expected: Supabase rejects the credentials; an inline error message is shown; user stays on LoginScreen

name: test_login_empty_fields_validation
scenario: Submitting the Login form with both fields empty must not reach Supabase (no network call for invalid data)
expected: zod validation blocks submission; user remains on LoginScreen; no navigation occurs
actual: still_on_login=True, validation_error_text_shown=False, supabase_auth_network_calls=0 (see BUG-002 in Defect Report: LoginScreen shows no visible feedback on empty submit)

name: test_login_malformed_email_validation
scenario: Entering a malformed email ('not-an-email') into Login and submitting must not reach Supabase
expected: zod .email() validation rejects the value; user remains on LoginScreen

name: test_google_sign_in_button_present
scenario: 'Continue with Google' button is present and enabled on LoginScreen (not clicked — would open real OAuth consent)
expected: Google sign-in pressable is present in the DOM

name: test_register_empty_fields_validation
scenario: Submitting the Register form with all fields empty must not reach Supabase
expected: zod validation blocks submission; user remains on RegisterScreen
actual: still_on_register=True, validation_error_text_shown=False, supabase_signup_network_calls=0 (RegisterScreen gates inline errors behind a manual per-field 'touched' flag that submit alone does not set — see Code Health Summary)

name: test_register_weak_password_validation
scenario: Registering with a password that fails the complexity regex (too short, no symbols) must not reach Supabase
expected: Submission blocked (stays on RegisterScreen). Note: the password field has no dedicated inline error Text in source — RegisterScreen.tsx:391 deliberately replaces it with a requirements checklist, so this test does not require visible error TEXT for this field.

name: test_register_password_mismatch_validation
scenario: Registering with password and confirmPassword that do not match must not reach Supabase
expected: zod .refine() mismatch blocks submission; user remains on RegisterScreen

name: test_register_valid_input_clears_validation_errors
scenario: Filling Register form with fully valid data clears all inline errors (submit NOT clicked — would create a real Supabase user)
expected: No validation error text visible once all fields satisfy the zod schema

name: test_forgot_password_malformed_email_validation
scenario: Submitting Forgot Password with a malformed email must not reach Supabase
expected: zod .email() validation rejects the value; no network call made; user remains on ForgotPasswordScreen

name: test_forgot_password_empty_email_validation
scenario: Submitting Forgot Password with an empty email field must not reach Supabase
expected: zod validation blocks submission; no network call made

name: test_logout_requires_authenticated_session
scenario: Logout (ProfileScreen.handleSignOut / SettingsScreen.signOut)
expected: N/A — requires an authenticated session
actual: Skipped: no authenticated test session available (see module scope note)
